# Mammoth Mountain

> > Mammoth Mountain is a premier year-round mountain resort in California's Eastern Sierra offering world-class skiing, snowboarding, terrain parks, golf, events, and luxury accommodations.

Located in Mammoth Lakes, California, the resort features multiple base lodges including Canyon Lodge and Main Lodge, connected by the Village Gondola. Mammoth Mountain is known for its 100+ acre Unbound Terrain Parks, partnerships with brands like Arc'teryx, and access via Ikon Pass, plus sister property June Mountain.

## Key Topics

- Mammoth Mountain
- Mammoth Lakes

## Mountain Features & Terrain

- [Unbound Terrain Parks | Mammoth Mountain](https://www.mammothmountain.com/on-the-mountain/unbound-terrain-parks): 100+ acres of terrain parks with 2 halfpipes and 100+ jibs at Mammoth
- [June Mountain Rail Jam | June Mountain](https://www.mammothmountain.com/things-to-do/events/june-rail-jam): Free all-ages rail jam at June Mountain Bunker Hill terrain park

## Ski & Snowboard Camps and Clinics

- [Women's Snowboard & Ski Camp | Mammoth Mountain](https://www.mammothmountain.com/discover-mammoth/camps-teams/multi-day-clinics/womens-clinics): Multi-day women's ski/snowboard camps with video analysis at Main Lodge
- [Arc'teryx Academy | Mammoth Mountain](https://www.mammothmountain.com/things-to-do/events/arcteryx-academy): Backcountry clinics, films, and music with Arc'teryx mountain guides
- [Ripping Over 50: More Than a Clinic | Mammoth Mountain Blog](https://www.mammothmountain.com/discover-mammoth/mammoth-blog/ripping-over-50-more-than-a-clinic): Ski camp for adults 50+ combining wellness, community, and progression
- [Learn To Skate Clinic | Tamarack XC | Mammoth Mountain](https://www.mammothmountain.com/things-to-do/events/tamarack-skate-clinic/mar-23): 4-week Nordic skate skiing beginner clinic at Tamarack XC Center

## Events & Après Ski

- [Weekend Après Party | Canyon Lodge | Mammoth Mountain (Apr 17)](https://www.mammothmountain.com/things-to-do/events/weekend-apres-party/apr-17): Friday-Saturday DJ parties at Canyon Lodge Sundeck with Lincoln Bar VIP
- [Weekend Après Party | Canyon Lodge | Mammoth Mountain (Feb 20)](https://www.mammothmountain.com/things-to-do/events/weekend-apres-party/feb-20): Arc'teryx-sponsored DJ party at Canyon Lodge, 21+ weekend event
- [Weekend Après Party | Canyon Lodge | Mammoth Mountain (Feb 27)](https://www.mammothmountain.com/things-to-do/events/weekend-apres-party/feb-27): Friday-Saturday après ski with DJ at Canyon Lodge Sundeck, 21+
- [Holiday Tree Lighting at The Village | Mammoth Mountain](https://www.mammothmountain.com/things-to-do/events/holiday-tree-lighting): Family holiday event with Santa, Woolly, and Village tree lighting
- [Party on June Mountain | Mammoth Mountain](https://www.mammothmountain.com/things-to-do/events/party-on-june-mountain): Summer alpine party with BBQ, beer, and live music at June Mountain

## Luxury Accommodations

- [The Reserve at Obsidian | Mammoth Mountain](https://www.mammothmountain.com/plan-your-trip/mammoth-hotels/the-reserve-at-obsidian): 4-bedroom luxury rental at Obsidian with Sierra Star Golf views
- [The Kestrel at Obsidian Residences | Mammoth Luxury Home Rentals](https://www.mammothmountain.com/plan-your-trip/mammoth-hotels/the-kestrel-at-obsidian): 5-bedroom luxury rental in gated Obsidian near Sierra Star Golf

## Family Services & Activities

- [Child Care | Ages 2–6 | Mammoth Mountain](https://www.mammothmountain.com/plan-your-trip/child-care/ages-2-to-6): Licensed child care at The Village for ages 2-6, hourly or full day
- [Kids Get Golf Ready | Sierra Star Golf Course](https://www.mammothmountain.com/things-to-do/events/kids-get-golf-ready/jun-23): 6-week youth golf program at Sierra Star for ages 5-11

## Resort Information & Updates

- [Resort Accessibility | Mammoth Mountain](https://www.mammothmountain.com/about/accessibility): ADA accessibility services, adaptive recreation, and disability support
- [Mammoth Mountain Avalanche Incident | March 25, 2025 | Operations Update](https://www.mammothmountain.com/discover-mammoth/mammoth-blog/operations-update-march-25): Rockslide avalanche incident report and Ski Patrol response update
